# osapi pki cert

Show and rotate the TLS certificates of osapi on this host.
`osapi dsl command get --name pki cert` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                            |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | pki cert                                                   |
| Description | Show and rotate the TLS certificates of osapi on this host |

## [osapi pki cert list](../../usage/cli/pki/cert/list.md)

|             |                                                                |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | list                                                           |
| Description | List the certificates, with their state, algorithms and expiry |

## [osapi pki cert get](../../usage/cli/pki/cert/get.md)

|             |                                                                     |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | get                                                                 |
| Description | Show one certificate in full: its names, algorithms and fingerprint |
| Refuses     | no name, a name of more than 64 characters                          |

### Flags (1)

| FLAG   | TYPE   | VALIDATE        | HELP                                                                |
| ------ | ------ | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| --name | string | required,max=64 | The name of the certificate, as list shows it, such as api or nats. |

## [osapi pki cert rotate](../../usage/cli/pki/cert/rotate.md)

|             |                                                            |

| Description | Make a new self-signed certificate in place of the old one |
